description:
Remove the decision-kind copies from the item and validate CLI suite.

## Background

`cli_item_validate/decision_kind_tests.rs` (`:15`, `:55`, `:175`) and `cli_item_validate/decision_risk_story_tests.rs` (`:16`, `:65`, `:131`) restate the decision kind and its `D-[0-9]+` id pattern. Shared test support derives the shipped item kinds from `profiles/jit-default/manifest.toml`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Tests in these files that need a shipped kind take it from the shared derivation of the default package.
- [hard] REQ-02: A test that needs a kind the package does not ship declares a minimal literal, and its name or comment says the kind is custom.
- [hard] REQ-03: No test in these files restates a shipped kind's declaration or its id pattern.
title: Decision-kind CLI tests take shipped item kinds from the default package
